semiconductor_relevance: High — CHYI DING Technologies specializes in cleanroom construction and environmental control systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Founded in 2003, CHYI DING Technologies Co., Ltd. focuses on designing and manufacturing equipment for mini-environment control, airborne molecular contamination removal, and energy-saving solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. The company also provides energy-saving consulting and cleanroom construction services, contributing significantly to carbon emission reduction.

regional_presence.Taiwan: CHYI DING Technologies is positioned as a leading semiconductor equipment manufacturer in Taiwan, aiming for 100% renewable energy usage by 2030.
